(#{item.physicalId}, #{item.residentId}, #{item.projectCode}, #{item.projectName}, #{item.itemCode}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.resultValue}, #{item.resultNum}, #{item.unit}, #{item.refLow}, #{item.refHigh}, #{item.abnormalFlag}, #{item.deviceCode}, #{item.operator}, #{item.examTime}, 0, 1, NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result_value = VALUES(result_value), result_num = VALUES(result_num), abnormal_flag = VALUES(abnormal_flag), exam_time = VALUES(exam_time), update_time = NOW()
